action: In a fresh scene, adds the concept sheet (front, side and back views in one image) as an Image Empty and moves it in Front Orthographic.
tool: Add > Image > Reference/Empty (Display As Image), Move (G)
view: Front Orthographic, Object Mode, Layout workspace
why: Put the orthographic concept behind the model to trace from

action: Sets up the image Empty: size 5 m, offset -0.5/-0.5, depth Back, opacity 0.3, shown in Orthographic and Perspective, then nudges it so the front figure's feet sit on the origin.
tool: Object Data Properties of Image Empty, Move redo panel
why: Make the reference faint, behind the mesh, and aligned to the world origin
reader_equivalent: e.empty_display_size=5; e.empty_image_offset=(-0.5,-0.5); e.empty_image_depth='BACK'; e.use_empty_image_alpha=True; e.color[3]=0.3; e.location.x+=0.038; e.location.z-=0.0285

action: Duplicates the Empty (Empty.001), moves it -5.2896 m in X so the side figure lines up with the origin, and checks it in Right Orthographic.
tool: Duplicate (Shift D), Move redo panel, Numpad 1 / Numpad 3 views
why: A second copy gives a side-view reference using the same sheet
reader_equivalent: e2=e.copy(); scene.collection.objects.link(e2); e2.location.x-=5.2896; e2.rotation_euler.z=1.5708 (rotation to face the Right view is inferred, not seen)
